title: Unrealized Potential
notes: Fix: S User 2026-10-26: the copy must not be halved a second time: total stays equal, split over two events (100 -> 50 + 50); the code gives 50 + 25. Fix: skip the second halving for the copy. | 2026-10-26 hook batch F1 built (research/hooks_F1.json, loader/hooks_F1.c). In each of the 5 stat-gain builders (Attack L341, Defense L349, Intelligence L340, Speed L344, Max Health L335) the var get of amount that feeds the queued copy now returns the pre-halving amount; the copy halves itself on its own pass, so 100 -> 50 + 50. In-game test: Unrealized Potential holder gains a stat (e.g. +100 Attack): the log shows two gains of 50 (was 50 + 25).

release_notes.intended: The creature gains these stats an additional time, 50% fewer.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the extra copy was halved twice (50% + 25%).
release_notes.fix: Now the extra copy is 50% of the stats (50% + 50%).
